rv.q: The middle playlet offers its own trio of characters, with three very different versions of an author, Annabel, being interviewed about her work. At first, Annabel is a self-effacing Dublin poet who has moved into writing mediocre but popular “mid-culture” novels, and who is petrified by the world.

In the original version, Annie, a geriatric without a home, opened the show with her recollections of her past, but now Anna, the anxious Gen Z graduate battling dating, beauty, and career expectations, appears first. This play is a gift for a solo actress, who has to make many changes in appearance and costume over a 75-minute run.
